          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=current_schema() AND TABLE_NAME='old_table'), '|',
          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM added_table), '|',
          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT n.nspname::text AS table_schema, c.relname::text AS table_name, CASE WHEN i.indisprimary THEN 'PRIMARY' ELSE ic.relname::text END AS index_name, (NOT i.indisunique)::int AS non_unique, k.n::int AS seq_in_index, a.attname::text AS column_name FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = i.indrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace JOIN pg_class ic ON ic.oid = i.indexrelid CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(i.indkey::int2[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum, n) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attnum = k.attnum WHERE n.nspname = 'public') AS statistics WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=current_schema() AND TABLE_NAME='parent' AND INDEX_NAME='parent_payload'), '|',
          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parent WHERE payload='one'))
